seed_note:
本文件是种子模板，随 skill 分发。项目初始化时复制成 <项目>/style-registry.json，再按项目实际用到的风格增删条目。schema 与字段含义见 references/风格注册表_style-registry.md。 分发口径：本 seed 只装已落值条目（当前 26 个，v5.42.0 批 3 + 备选批扩容后）；待建 id 与 pixel-2d 条件准入的全表见 references/风格路由表.md 第二节——引用待建 id 不在注册表内，check_style 报 S2-STYLE-UNREGISTERED（同为 ERROR 拦截，与 SKILL.md「引用待建是 P0 级错误」口径一致）。 v2：补 urban-folk-filmstill 条目（2026-10-12 诊断修复：锚文件与路由表早已登记，唯 L0 漏条目致 check_style 误报 S2）。 v3：落值平面工艺轨四风格（2026-10-12）。 v4：补登 8 对互斥 excludes（2026-10-13 深度扫描 P0-3：S5 串轨检测只扫已登记对，celshade↔pixar/anime↔gothic-puppet/anime↔pixar/webtoon↔npr/webtoon↔gothic-puppet/webtoon↔pixar/webtoon↔gothic-2d/documentary↔gothic-puppet 漏登记致串轨盲区；photoreal-pbr↔urban-folk-filmstill 为「同轨实拍分支共存」有意设计，仍不互斥）。 v5：色值 extended 全量补登（2026-10-13 深度扫描 P1-3：14 个锚的色值表超出 L0 三色，共 65 值按锚表「用途/说明」登记进 extended，落实模板硬规则「L1 每个色值都能在 L0 找到」）。 v6：补两项 L1 声明登记（2026-10-13 深度扫描 P2 C5：皮影2D 锚 §五/§六 的「同框人形上限三个」登记进 shadow-puppet-2d collapse_risks；国漫赛璐璐2D 锚 §四 运镜池「少量」行的「快速推拉（演出用）」登记进 celshade-guoman-2d motion_pool.limited——两处锚声明此前不在 L0 对应字段，落实 L1 不得超出 L0 的纪律）。 v7：落值 thickpaint-2d（厚涂二次元，v4.9.1 批 1 首个；来源：外部风格趋势调研（评审底稿，不随包分发）第五节，频次最高的待建项）：新增全字段条目，并与既有 16 个 id 双向登记 excludes（六个方向全部互斥，含同轨的 anime-2d / celshade-guoman-2d / webtoon-2d / gothic-2d）；与 korean-illust-2d 的边界按「厚涂管笔触与明暗逻辑，韩系插画管题材与光色」划分，后者维持待建。 v8：photoreal-pbr↔urban-folk-filmstill 的不互斥已在 v4 声明为有意设计，v4.9.1 补进风格路由表互斥矩阵正下方，避免后续被当漏项误补（两者差别是精修度不是画风类别，漂移由市井锚崩点管）。 v9：落值 claymation-3d（通用黏土定格，v4.9.1 批 1 第二）：新增全字段条目并与既有 17 个 id 双向登记 excludes；与 gothic-puppet 的边界定为「题材与光色」（通用暖调 vs 哥特暗黑）不是材质，羊毛毡并入本锚作子档（表面绒毛与缝线 vs 指痕压光），不单开 id。 v10：落值 comic-popart-2d（美漫波普）与 ghibli-2d（吉卜力系）（v4.9.1 批 1 第三、第四个）：各新增全字段条目并与既有 id 双向登记 excludes；波普的网点与撞色是图形不是文字，与禁可读文字铁律不冲突，但对话框与拟声词仍属可读文字须改为纯图形符号；吉卜力为西式透明水彩，与 ink-wash-2d 的东方水墨登记互斥。
marker_words 粒度原则（v5.34.0 实战确立）：特征词 = 出现即高度疑似该锚的**特异性词**；多锚共有的材质词不得入表——「毛孔」曾被 urban-folk-filmstill 收录，而全部 20 份风格锚的九段原文都含它，照抄自家规范即报 S5 串轨（已移除）。待观察的同属通用汉语摄影词：「留白」（ink-wash-2d）、「背光」（shadow-puppet-2d），暂未实测误伤，先留痕不动。 v11：落值批 3 全部四锚（lowpoly-iso-3d / dark-anime-2d / dunhuang-gongbi-2d / chibi-qban-2d）与两个已被决策器引用的稳档备选（shinkai-2d / gouache-2d）（v5.42.0 风格专项升级）：各新增全字段条目并与既有 20 个 id 双向登记 excludes（每对含对因，见各锚文件 9.2）；chibi 的头身档 2-3 是本体定义，负面词不含 Q 版（v5.2.0 反向自打脸防线的镜像应用）；dark-anime 内置恐怖题材过审红线（血只走事后状态与光影）。 v12：marker 词粒度批量修正（v5.42.0 风格扩容实测发现）。实机 E2E 抓到 celshade 的「两段式阴影」在 chibi 包正面文本误报 S5；按 S5 精确口径全量复算出 14 对真实误伤。修正：celshade 改用「边缘分明的两段式阴影」与 EN 长短语（弃裸「两段式阴影」「catchlight」——chibi/dark-anime 本体同款）；gothic-2d 弃泛词「墨线勾边 / ink outlines」（与水墨/年画/波普共有）；gothic-puppet 与 claymation 互让「黏土 / 微缩布景 / miniature set photography」（同轨姊妹风格共料）；guofeng 改「国产院线 3D 动画」（弃泛词「3D 动画电影」）；photoreal 改「with PBR materials and real cinematic lighting」（guofeng EN 正面含 PBR materials）；shadow-puppet 改「translucent shadow puppet」（urban-folk EN 正面含 translucent）；ink-wash 弃「宣纸」（年画同用）。教训与 v5.34.0 一致：marker 必须是特异性词，新增锚后必须跑全量撞车复算。

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅当代中国城市的写实实拍电影画面，取的是老胶片志怪剧照那一路。整体低饱和、低对比，暗部压深但保留细节，绝不死黑。皮肤可见毛孔、细纹与眼袋，不做磨皮，也不取网红面孔。布料起毛、水泥返碱、旧木开裂在近距离都清晰可辨。每一镜只有一个有依据的实用光源，方向写得到，衰减自然，留下大面积真实阴影。中式民俗元素只允许作为写实画面之上的一层薄薄叠加：肩头一缕淡灰烟气、身后一层半透明巨兽轮廓。画面本体始终是实拍的街道、楼道与写字楼，任何一处都不许变成绘制出来的平面绘画。
tech_spec.render_en: A photoreal live-action film frame of a present-day Chinese city, shot like an old film-strip still of a folk ghost story. Muted and desaturated overall, deep shadows that keep detail, never crushed to black. Skin shows pores, fine lines and fatigue, no beauty smoothing, no influencer faces. Worn cloth nap, efflorescent concrete and cracked old timber all read at close range. Exactly one practical motivated light source per shot, its direction stated, natural falloff, large true shadow areas. Supernatural elements appear only as a thin layer over the realistic image: a pale smoke wisp above a shoulder, a translucent beast outline behind a man. The frame itself is always real streets, corridors and office floors, never a painted flat plane or a fantasy realm.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 低饱和配色：都市冷灰为底，旧木暗褐压住暗部，唯一暖色重音只由画面里唯一的实用光源承担。
tech_spec.palette_en: desaturated palette: cold urban grey as the ground, dark warm brown holding the shadows, with a single warm accent carried only by the one practical light source in frame
tech_spec.material_rule: 皮肤与布料必须带不完美词（毛孔、细纹、眼袋至少两项）；光源必须有画面内依据并写明入射角与衰减；民俗元素一镜只留一件，用词限定为一缕淡灰烟气与一层半透明轮廓

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅单层平面剪纸作品，从一整张哑光红纸上剪出，传统中国红纸风。所有形状由负形镂空界定，刀刻硬边，无抗锯齿、无柔过渡。镂空处透出暖白纸底，纯黑只用于最内层勾边。均匀平光，无方向光、无投影、无渐变、无三维渲染、无景深。动效是跳切式换位，每拍一个静止姿态，不滑动。一帧只许一处金箔点缀。
tech_spec.render_en: A single-layer flat papercut artwork in traditional Chinese red-paper style, cut from one sheet of matte red paper. All shapes are defined by negative-space cutouts with hard cut edges, no anti-aliasing and no soft transitions. The visible ground is warm rice-paper white, with pure black used only for the innermost outline. Even frontal lighting, no directional light, no cast shadows, no gradients, no three-dimensional rendering, no depth of field. Motion is cut-and-swap: the subject holds one still pose per beat, never glides. A single gold-foil accent appears exactly once in the frame.

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅暗黑哥特风格的平面 2D 动画画面，走的是维多利亚暗黑童话那一路。整体压在冷月雾蓝与墨黑紫之间，明暗对比拉到剪影级别，但暗部始终留得住形，绝不死黑。手绘墨线勾边，线条细而匀、带轻微手抖；色块平涂，硬边剪影式阴影，画面里没有任何渐变、体积光、高光与景深虚化。人物瘦长脆弱，四肢与指节明显拉长，肩窄，头略大，眼大而深陷，眼窝一片阴影；肤色是苍白灰调，不带红晕。唯一重音色只由画面里的一处红色物件承担，暖光只来自画面唯一的实用光源，其余全部压进同色系冷灰。画面本体始终是一张平面的画，任何一处都不许变成 3D 渲染、摄影实拍或立体建模。
tech_spec.render_en: A flat 2D animated frame in dark gothic style, along the line of Victorian dark fairy-tale illustration. The image is held between cold moon-mist blue and ink-black purple, contrast pushed to the level of a silhouette while the darks still keep their shapes, never crushed flat. Hand-drawn ink outlines, thin and even with a slight tremor; flat colour fills; hard-edged shadow shapes; no gradient, no volumetric light, no highlight, no depth-of-field blur. Figures are thin and fragile, limbs and finger joints noticeably elongated, narrow shoulders, slightly oversized heads, large deep-set eyes under heavy brow shadow; skin is pale grey with no flush. The only warm accent is carried by a candle, a lantern or the moon; everything else is pressed into the same cold grey family. The frame itself is always a flat drawing, never a 3D render, a photograph or a modelled solid.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 冷灰配色：月雾灰蓝为底，墨黑紫压住暗部与轮廓，唯一重音色只由画面里的一处红色物件承担，暖光只来自画面唯一的实用光源。
tech_spec.palette_en: cold palette: moon-mist blue-grey as the ground, ink-black purple holding the shadows and the outlines, with a single accent carried only by one red object in frame, the warm light itself coming from the one practical source and counted separately

tech_spec.render_en: A claymation stop-motion film, handcrafted and shot as real miniature set photography. Characters are hand-modelled clay puppets with oversized heads, thin limbs and surfaces that keep fingerprint dents, tool marks and seam lines, all matte and non-glossy. The set is a real built miniature with visible board seams, dried moss, flocking and hand-weathered surfaces. One warm key light with soft fill casts soft short shadows, not CG lighting. Movement carries stop-motion step timing with no motion blur. It is handmade practical stop-motion, not a 3D render.

tech_spec.palette_en: warm clay palette of cream highlights, warm brown clay body and shadows and a single terracotta-red accent, with warm violet-grey cast shadows that are never black
